topic: Sleep is built, not owed (companion Reel, off grid)
caption:
The alarm after a bad night does more than you might think.

The pull to sleep builds from the moment you get up, so a sleep-in starts it later and leaves less for bedtime. Keeping your usual wake time gives that pressure the whole day to build.

The short version of this week's carousel. The full carousel is on our profile @equal_psychology, and the full article is linked in bio.
